calibration.chosen_by: lowest out-of-sample log-loss (2-fold time split of validation)

derivation.review_amount: 1.25 x largest fraud amount in the fit period (1,371.81), rounded up to 500
derivation.far_from_home_km: 2 x largest home-merchant distance in the fit period, rounded up to 100 km
derivation.spend_spike: grid search on validation, lowest total cost of policy + rule (ties -> stricter)
